cues.en: Very well.
They are coming.

cues.zh: 让我们看看这些俄国人怎么对付一个被打残的党卫军师。
cues.en: Let us see how these Russians deal with a cracked SS Division.
Uh.. Hans..
Have courage my friend!
Uh, yeah, Hans..
I have just noticed something.

cues.zh: 这些共党分子全是胆小鬼！
cues.en: These Communists are all cowards!

cues.zh: 不……你最近看过我们的帽子吗？
cues.en: No.. have you looked at our Caps recently?
Our Caps?

cues.zh: 对，我们帽子上的徽章，你看过吗？
cues.en: Yeah, the badges on our Caps, have you looked at them?
What?
No, a bit..?
They have got skulls on them.

cues.zh: 你注意到没有，我们帽子上居然画着小骷髅头。
cues.en: Have you notived that our Caps have actually got little pictures of skulls on them.
I don't uh...
Hans... are we the baddies?

cues.zh: 我们在这儿至少能守上几个小时。
cues.en: We should be able to hold them at this point here for at least a few hours.
But why skulls though?
what?
Why skulls?

cues.zh: 嗯，也许那是我们敌人的骷髅头！
cues.en: Well, maybe they are the skulls of our enemies!

cues.zh: 也许吧，但给人的感觉是这样吗？
cues.en: Maybe, but is that how it comes across?

cues.zh: 骷髅头旁边又没写：“你知道，没错我们杀了他，但相信我，这家伙是个
cues.en: It doesn't say next to the skull, "You know, yeah we killed him but trust us this guy was
horrid."
Well, no.
But...

cues.zh: 我是说，骷髅会让你想到什么？
cues.en: I mean what do skulls make you think of?

cues.zh: 死亡、食人族、斩首、呃、海盗……？
cues.en: Death, Canibals, beheading, um, pirates..?
Pirates are fun!

cues.zh: 我没说我们有趣，但有趣与否，海盗终究是坏人。
cues.en: I didn't say we were fun, but fun or not, pirates are still the baddies.

cues.zh: 我就是想不出骷髅有什么好的。
cues.en: I just can not think of anything good about a skull.

cues.zh: 那纯粹的雅利安 skull shape 呢？
cues.en: What about pure Aryan skull shape?

cues.zh: 而且那通常更多是画成还带着皮肤的样子。
cues.en: And that is usually more pictured with skin still on.
And then there are the allies...

cues.zh: 哦，你没在听盟国的宣传吗？
cues.en: Oh, you haven't been listening to allied propaganda?

cues.zh: 他们当然会说我们是坏人！
cues.en: Of course they are going to say we are the bad guys!

cues.zh: 但他们可没机会设计我们的制服！
cues.en: But they didn't get to design our uniforms!

cues.zh: 他们的标志都挺好看的！
cues.en: Their symbols are all quite nice!
Stars, stripes, lions, sickles..
what is so good about a sickle?

cues.zh: 嗯，没什么，而且显然我们在最后一千英里撤退中学到的最后一件事
cues.en: Well, nothing and obviously the last thing we learned in the last thousand miles of retreat

cues.zh: 就是俄罗斯农业急需机械化。但你得这么说
cues.en: is that the Russian agriculture is in dire need of maganization.But you gotta say it
is better than a skull!

cues.zh: 我是说，真想不到还有什么比骷髅更糟的象征了！
cues.en: I mean, I really can not think of anything worse as a symbol than a skull!
Um, a rat's anus?!

cues.zh: 是啊，要是我们对抗的是一支打着老鼠肛门旗号的军队，我反倒
cues.en: Yeah, and if we fighting an army marching under the banner of a rat's anus I would be
a lot less worried, Hans!
